data.title: AArete Recognized Among Forbes’ World’s Best Management Consulting Firms for Fifth Consecutive Year
data.description: Chicago-based consulting firm AArete was recognized as one of Forbes' World's Best Management Consulting Firms for 2026. AArete is known for its expertise in management and technology consulting on a global scale.

data.title: Starcloud Raises $250 Million at $2.3 Billion Valuation to Scale AI with Orbital Data Centers
data.description: A tech corporation based in Redmond, Washington, known as Starcloud, is leading the advancement of data centers in space. In a recent development, the company unveiled an additional funding round totaling $250 million as part of their Series A funding extension. This brings the company's post-money valuation to $2.3 billion. The prominent investor in this round is Manhattan West, accompanied by existing investors like Benchmark, EQT, Soma, NFX, 776, and others. Moreover, major new investors joining this round include NVIDIA, Cisco Investments, Cedar Capital, Goanna Capital, Standard Capital, and others. With this latest funding, Starcloud has now raised a total of $450 million in capital.

data.title: BlueWhale Research Holds Lead Rejection Under 1% Across 45,000 Leads a Month with ZoomInfo
data.description: In Vancouver, ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) announced that BlueWhale Research, a B2B lead generation firm catering to technology firms, generates over 45,000 leads monthly. Impressively, their lead rejection rate has stayed under 1% for five years, contrasting with the industry norm of 15-20% in third-party lead generation. BlueWhale, recognized as an Inc. 5000 entity, consistently produces hundreds of thousands of qualified leads.

data.title: Cleveland-Cliffs Announces $1 Billion Middletown Works Investment to be Supported by $500 Million U.S. Department of Energy Award
data.description: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. revealed today that the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) has provided a roadmap for the finalization of negotiations and implementation plans regarding its Middletown Works investment. The $500 million DOE grant has been repurposed, with the new optimization project now amounting to a total investment of $1 billion in Middletown Works. Cleveland-Cliffs and the DOE will each contribute half of the funding for this project. This major investment is anticipated to have significant impacts.

data.title: California Pizza Kitchen Partners With T-ROC Global for National Expansion of Automated Retail Kiosks
data.description: In a recent collaboration, California Pizza Kitchen (CPK) has teamed up with T-ROC Global to enhance accessibility to their products. CPK, known for its innovative California-inspired pizzas, is set to broaden its reach through the deployment of advanced retail solutions. The partnership aims to introduce a series of up to 1,000 CPK automated retail machines across the United States. T-ROC Global, a prominent technology-driven retail service provider, will be responsible for the implementation and management of these automated CPK retail outlets, marking a significant expansion strategy for the renowned restaurant brand.
